children: Adial Pharmaceuticals executed two amendments to its financing agreements to address accounting treatment of Milestone Warrants and support Nasdaq compliance. The company amended its Securities Purchase Agreement with certain PIPE investors and its Note Exchange Agreements with certain Former Azora noteholders to remove a penalty provision and add lock-up restrictions on specific shares issuable upon exercise of pre-funded warrants. Management expects these changes to shift the Milestone Warrants from liability to equity classification, improving reported stockholders' equity ahead of its Annual Meeting and anticipated change in control.
